instruction:
Workflow launch paths: LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`; Blender: `/home/user/Applications/blender-4.2.3-linux-x64/blender`. Required four-software transfer workflow: LibreCAD -> FreeCAD -> KiCad -> Blender. Start from the provided seed DXF /home/user/Desktop/seed_terminal_cover_long.dxf; do not start from a blank or unrelated drawing. Run the stages in order. Each stage must read the preceding stage output, and every required intermediate file must be saved on the Desktop. The design token for this task is EW4G08; keep this token visible in the DXF labels and KiCad silkscreen. The Blender output must visibly consume the stage-2 STL and stage-3 SVG through Blender's native import/export operations.

Design goal: Eight-channel terminal cover with numbered windows. This case is intentionally different from the other benchmark cases: domain=industrial_terminal_cover, mechanical target=a long transparent-smoke cover with the eight numbered terminal windows visible, electronics target=an eight-channel terminal PCB with TERM1 through TERM8, 24V, GND, and channel-number silk.

1. LibreCAD stage: open the provided seed file /home/user/Desktop/seed_terminal_cover_long.dxf in LibreCAD, use it as the starting drawing, complete the required 2D geometry, remove all GUIDE construction entities, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage1_terminal_cover_long.dxf. Use millimeters. Use layers OUTLINE, WINDOW, HOLE, LABEL. The overall drawing envelope must be 165 mm x 52 mm. Include the required circular features: center (8,8) radius 2.2; center (157,8) radius 2.2; center (8,44) radius 2.2; center (157,44) radius 2.2. Add readable labels EW4G08, CH1, CH8, 24V, GND on the LABEL layer.
2. FreeCAD stage: import /home/user/Desktop/stage1_terminal_cover_long.dxf in FreeCAD. Create the 3D mechanical body from that LibreCAD DXF, and export the body as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long.stl with an approximate bounding size of 165 mm x 52 mm x 14 mm. Then, from the same FreeCAD model, export a top-face or board-interface outline for KiCad as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long_handoff_outline.dxf. This handoff DXF must represent the same XY envelope as the FreeCAD body and include the visible labels FREECAD_TO_KICAD and EW4G08.
3. KiCad stage: open KiCad and import the complete /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long_handoff_outline.dxf onto Dwgs.User so its interface graphics and the FREECAD_TO_KICAD/EW4G08 text remain available. Create one aligned 165 mm x 52 mm Edge.Cuts outline from the imported outer boundary, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage3_terminal_cover_long_board.kicad_pcb. Add eight native terminal footprints for TERM1 through TERM8 with at least two pads each, plus one native power footprint with at least four pads, for at least 20 native pads total. Bind native pad nets CH1 through CH8, 24V, and GND. Keep all footprints inside the board. Add F.SilkS silkscreen text carrying KICAD_TO_BLENDER, EDGE_FROM_STAGE2_HANDOFF, the stage2 handoff filename, EW4G08, and these board tokens: EW4G08, TERM1, TERM2, TERM3, TERM4, TERM5, TERM6, TERM7, TERM8, 24V, GND. Then use KiCad's plot/export workflow to create the Blender handoff SVG /home/user/Desktop/stage3_terminal_cover_long_board_profile.svg from the same Edge.Cuts outline.
4. Blender stage: open Blender. Import /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long.stl with File > Import > STL, then import /home/user/Desktop/stage3_terminal_cover_long_board_profile.svg with File > Import > Scalable Vector Graphics (.svg). Keep the imported STL body object and the imported SVG board/profile geometry visible, full scale, and aligned in the active scene. Give the cover a visibly transparent-smoke material using either alpha blending or glTF transmission, and retain eight substantial visible terminal-window frames with visible CH1 through CH8 number geometry. Export glTF Binary (.glb) as /home/user/Desktop/stage4_terminal_cover_long.glb. Do not manually inject handoff metadata.

Required deliverables on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/stage1_terminal_cover_long.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long.stl, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_terminal_cover_long_handoff_outline.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_terminal_cover_long_board.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_terminal_cover_long_board_profile.svg, /home/user/Desktop/stage4_terminal_cover_long.glb.

[Software] Use LibreCAD first, then FreeCAD, then KiCad, then Blender. Do not skip stages, reorder stages, or recreate the final result in only one software package.
